summary: Senstar Technologies filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its annual general meeting held June 29, 2026, at its Ottawa, Ontario office. Shareholders approved the re-election of directors Gillon Beck, Jacob Berman, Tom Overwijn, and Kelli Roiter, and the appointment of Ernst & Young LLP as auditor for the ensuing year. All resolutions passed by the requisite majority under the Ontario Business Corporation Act. The filing contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or other corporate change. This is a routine annual meeting outcome report, not actionable for event-driven strategies.
